info.title: St Paul's choir attendance API
info.description: REST API for choir events, attendance, members, feedback, and FAQs. Local apps authenticate with httpOnly cookies. Send header X-Auth-Client: bearer on sign-in to receive token and refreshToken in JSON, then use Authorize in this UI.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Register, sign in, session, and password

tags.name: Attendance
tags.description: Marks for one event or a singer's history

tags.name: Members
tags.description: Roster, accounts, and singer feedback. Admin only.

bearerAuth.description: Access token from a response that included X-Auth-Client: bearer.

accessCookie.name: token
accessCookie.description: httpOnly access cookie set by login, refresh, and change-password when X-Auth-Client is omitted.

BearerClient.name: X-Auth-Client
BearerClient.description: Send bearer to receive token and refreshToken in the JSON body.

From.name: from
From.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Ignored when eventId is set.

To.name: to
To.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Ignored when eventId is set.

LiturgicalColorQuery.name: liturgicalColor
LiturgicalColorQuery.description: white, green, purple, red, black, or __none__ for events with no color.

BadRequest.description: The request body or query is not valid.

Unauthorized.description: Sign-in is missing or the session expired.

Forbidden.description: The account cannot perform this action yet, or the role is wrong.

Conflict.description: Username or email is already in use.

TooManyRequests.description: Auth rate limit: 30 requests per 15 minutes per IP.

ChoirVoicePart.description: Voice part accepted when creating an account. other remains on older records.

AttendanceStatus.description: late is accepted on write and shown on read. Stored rows use present plus late: true.

onRoster.description: Always true for a member. True for an admin who still sings.

refreshToken.description: Present when X-Auth-Client is bearer. Send it to /api/auth/refresh.

rate.description: round((present + late) / (present + absent + late) * 100). Excused is excluded.

503.description: Database is down, or the process is shutting down.

post.description: Creates a pending member. The singer cannot use the choir routes until an admin approves the account.

username.description: Lowercase letters, numbers, dots, underscores, or hyphens. Must start with a letter or number.

201.description: Account created. Cookies are set unless X-Auth-Client is bearer.

200.description: Signed in. Scope is full, pending, or must-change-password.

post.description: Reads the refreshToken cookie, or the JSON body when using bearer mode. Issues a new access token and a new refresh token.
Revokes the refresh token and clears cookies.

get.description: Re-issues the session when the token scope is behind the user record, for example after approval or a password change.

200.description: Current user. token and refreshToken are included when the session was re-issued and X-Auth-Client is bearer.
Voice range, pathway, and feedback history.

post.description: Clears mustChangePassword and issues a new full session when the account is otherwise allowed in.

parameters.name: memberId
parameters.description: Admin only. Limit events by this singer's attendance.

patch.description: Replaces title, date, type, notes, and liturgical color. Omitted type becomes practice and omitted notes become empty.

delete.description: Also deletes attendance rows for the event.

200.description: Summary and one page of history. A status filter or eventId rebuilds the summary from those rows.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated: date, event, type, color, status, notes. Omit to include every column.

200.description: PDF or Excel file for the full filtered history.

get.description: Admin. Optional eventId and userId filters. Not paginated.
Admin. Active approved singers, plus admins with onRoster true. Unmarked rows have an empty status.

put.description: Admin. status may be present, absent, late, or excused. Notes max 500 characters. Singers omitted from records are saved as absent. Rows must be approved roster members.

get.description: Admin. Available even when the admin still has mustChangePassword set.

200.description: Pending, inactive, and declined members, plus every admin.

post.description: Admin. New members are approved. role defaults to member.

onRoster.description: For an admin, false means they do not sing.

get.description: Admin. Same filters as the roster, with every matching row.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated: name, username, email, voice, range, pathway, role, rate, detail, status.

patch.description: Admin. A new password sets mustChangePassword. The last admin cannot be demoted. Omitting onRoster keeps the current value.

delete.description: Admin. Removes the user and their attendance. Does not delete admin accounts through the member-only lookup.

patch.description: Admin. Send any of voiceRange (max 200), feedback (max 2000), or choirPathway. Each value is appended to that history.
Admin. Deactivated people cannot sign in and drop off take-attendance. History is kept.

get.description: Singers see published member and both. Admins see published admin and both. manage=true returns every FAQ, including drafts.

parameters.name: audience
parameters.description: Admin filter on the published list.
